name: home-assistant
description: Connect to Home Assistant through its official MCP server.

app.kipster.name: Home Assistant
app.kipster.addressPrompt: What is your Home Assistant instance or account MCP address?

research.notes: Home Assistant's built-in Model Context Protocol Server integration serves Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp on the person's own instance (template URL), exposing the Assist API and only the entities the person exposes; an administrator account is required by default. Its IndieAuth OAuth uses the client's base URL as client ID, and the docs state client_id_metadata_document_supported true and no RFC 7591 registration endpoint; remote access needs Home Assistant Cloud (paid) or a tunnel, while Kipster on the same network can reach it directly. Discovery 2026-10-09: per-instance metadata not readable without an instance; docs state CIMD yes, DCR no. Registry servers (e.g. io.github.homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp) are community projects.

probe.reason: An instance or account MCP address is required when connecting
